name: Seersucker
author: E. T. Carter
description: Several travelling wave sources radiate at once and their phases sum into shifting standing-wave bands, like crinkled seersucker cloth. A fine dot grid samples that interference, the dots swelling on the crests and sinking in the troughs.

params.label: Dot spacing
params.effect: Distance between dots in CSS px - a dense fine sampling of the interference at the minimum, an open sparse grid at the maximum.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Base radius of the dots. Small reads as a fine pucker; large fattens the crest dots into bold beads.

params.label: Swell
params.effect: How much a crest swells each dot. 0 holds them uniform; high pumps the standing-wave bands into a strong puckered relief.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Wavelength of the interfering sources; short packs a tight busy pucker, long opens broad rolling bands.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the waves travel; 0 freezes a single standing interference pattern.

params.label: Sources
params.effect: How many wave sources interfere. Two gives clean parallel bands; more sources knot the interference into a busier woven pucker.

params.label: Source spread
params.effect: How far the sources sit from centre. Tight clusters give broad slow bands; wide spread tightens the interference into fine cross-hatching.

params.label: Interference contrast
params.effect: Contrast between crest and trough. Low blurs the pucker into a gentle swell; high snaps it into sharp bright bands on near-black.

params.label: Field glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft continuous colour washing the interference bands behind the dots. 0 leaves bare dots; high paints the standing wave in moving light.

params.label: Dot brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the dots themselves. Low keeps them subtle, high makes the crest pucker pop in vivid colour.

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Edge hardness of the dots. Low is soft glowing pucker; high snaps them to crisp high-contrast beads.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the dot grid off the upright axis so the sampling rows run diagonally across the interference.
